# Blood and Transfusions
Blood lost to bleeding has to be put back. Stop the bleeding first, then give blood, plasma or saline through a blood pack or an IV stand. See [textlink="Wounds and Bleeding" link="CMUGuideMedicalWounds"].
## Blood Types Everyone has a blood type, picked in character creation. It's printed on their ID card, and a health analyzer shows it next to their blood level. - Blood packs are labelled with their type. Blood from the WeYu Blood Dispenser comes in every type. - Only give blood the patient can take, the same as real life. [bold]O-[/bold] blood can go to anyone, and [bold]AB+[/bold] patients can take any blood.
Who can take which blood: - [bold]O-[/bold] patients: O- only. - [bold]O+[/bold]: O- and O+. - [bold]A-[/bold]: O- and A-. - [bold]A+[/bold]: O-, O+, A- and A+. - [bold]B-[/bold]: O- and B-. - [bold]B+[/bold]: O-, O+, B- and B+. - [bold]AB-[/bold]: O-, A-, B- and AB-. - [bold]AB+[/bold]: any type.
- [color=red]The wrong type is destroyed in the bloodstream[/color]. It restores nothing, and it poisons the patient. - Drawing blood from someone into an empty pack labels it with their type. Filling one pack from two different types makes it [color=red]mixed[/color], safe for nobody. An emptied pack can be refilled with any type.
## Keeping Blood Fresh - Blood and plasma [color=red]go bad after 30 minutes out of the fridge[/color]. The time adds up, and putting a pack back in the cold pauses it but doesn't reset it. - A [bold]freezer crate[/bold] or a full-size [bold]IV stand[/bold] keeps packs cold. A pack held in your hand or on a folding IV stand isn't. - Examining a pack tells you when it's getting warm, and when it's gone bad. - [color=red]Spoiled blood and plasma[/color] do no good and poison the patient. Saline doesn't spoil. - An empty pack can be refilled with fresh blood.
## Giving Blood
- [bold]From your hand[/bold]: use a pack on the patient to hook it up. It stays connected while you hold it. - [bold]Squeeze it[/bold]: use the connected pack in your hand to squeeze it. It runs in three times as fast for a few seconds; keep squeezing to keep it going. - [bold]IV stand[/bold]: hang the pack on a stand and drag the stand onto the patient. Fit a [bold]pressure bag[/bold] by using it on the stand and the drip runs twice as fast. Take it off again with the stand's alt-click option.
## Plasma - Plasma runs in twice as fast as whole blood. - Plasma packs are typed too, but [bold]plasma matches the other way round to blood[/bold], as in real life, and Rh doesn't matter: - [bold]AB[/bold] plasma can go to anyone. - [bold]A[/bold] plasma goes to A and O patients. - [bold]B[/bold] plasma goes to B and O patients. - [bold]O[/bold] plasma only goes to O patients. - For a while after it's given, it [bold]slows all bleeding by half[/bold], open wounds and internal bleeding alike. The more plasma, the longer it lasts, up to 5 minutes. - It doesn't stop bleeding: treat the wounds as usual.
## Saline - Saline fills lost blood volume for any blood type, but it isn't blood. - [color=red]If more than a quarter of a patient's blood is saline, it starts poisoning them[/color], harder the further past that it goes. - The health analyzer shows how much of the blood is saline. It turns orange once it's past the safe share. - The body slowly replaces saline with real blood. Use it to buy time, then follow up with blood.
